title: Position and direction words
examples: Teacher, where is the blue block compared to the red block?
Can you show me how to turn around?

explain.say: Position words tell you where something is. Look at the ball and the box.
The ball is higher than the box. So the ball is above the box.
The box is lower than the ball. So the box is below the ball.
The car is beside the teddy. So the car is next to the teddy.
The cup is on the table. The cat is under the table.

draw.text: on the table, under the table

explain.say: Hold up your left hand. Now hold up your right hand.
To turn means you change the way you face. Stand up and turn slowly.

faq.q: What does 'above' mean when I look at a shelf?
faq.a: It means something is higher up than the shelf. For example, a picture hanging on the wall above the shelf.
asks: Where is the book above the chair?

faq.a: They are very similar, but 'below' just means lower down. If a cloud is below the sun, it is lower in the sky.
asks: Can you show me something below?

faq.q: If I say 'next to', does it mean touching?
faq.a: It means it is right beside something else. The two things do not have to touch to be next to each other.
asks: What is next to your shoe?

faq.q: How do I know my left from my right?
faq.a: Hold up both hands with your fingers up and your thumbs out. Your left hand makes the shape of the letter L.
asks: Which hand is my left hand?
Can you check my left side?

faq.a: To turn means to change the way you are facing. You spin around to look in a different direction.

facts: Above means something is higher than another thing.
Below means something is lower than another thing.
Next to means something is beside something else.
We use left and right to talk about sides.
To turn means to change your direction or facing.

quiz.say: Look at the bird and the tree. Where is the bird?
quiz.why: The bird is higher than the tree. So the bird is above the tree.

wrong.0: Below means lower down, and the bird is high up.
wrong.2: Next to means beside, and the bird is high up over the tree.

quiz.say: Look at the two crayons. Where is the red crayon?
quiz.why: The crayons are side by side. So the red crayon is next to the blue one.

wrong.0: Above means higher up, and the crayons are side by side.
wrong.1: Under means lower down, and the crayons are side by side.

quiz.say: Face the door. Now face the window. What did you do?
quiz.why: You changed the way you face. That is a turn.

wrong.1: A jump goes up and down, and you still face the same way.
wrong.2: When you sit, you still face the same way.
